title: Connect the executable frontend to the separately earned compiler
statement: A verified source package and finite rational Pauli list acquire the input operations for the earlier pure-return compiler and its arbitrary-joint-input addendum. The consumer retains actual source output,private simulator emission/time records and prescribed quantum instruments,each with its own implementation cost. Classical observation receiving needs its separately verified diagonal-algebra/outcome-retention condition. Arbitrary adaptive intervention times,public artificial paths and normalized rare postselection are not imported. Non-Clifford coupling rotations are allowed only through paid acquired interfaces;the Python certificate module has not implemented the full quantum simulator. Ordinary retained-program/tableau/compiler methods remain equally informed competitors;practical superiority and hardness are unestablished.
